ASSIGN: Sets attributes on a part, order or customer, or a model variable, from expressions as it passes, for example a due date, a type or a counter.
BATCH: Groups parts or orders into batches, pallets or lots of a set size, or after a maximum wait, and sends the batch on as one entity.
BUFFER: Finite storage of waiting places between two machines or stations; when all places are taken the upstream machine stays blocked, holding its finished part.
CONVEYOR: Conveyor belt that carries parts from one end to the other at a set speed, holds a limited number, and blocks the machine before it when full.
CREATE: Source of arrivals: creates parts, orders, customers or jobs at random intervals or on an hourly arrival schedule.
DECIDE: Routing decision: sends each part, order or customer down one of several links by percentage chance, by a condition (rework, type, size) or by a policy.
DELAY: Pure waiting time (transit, curing, travel, a pause) that holds the entity for a sampled duration without using any machine, operator or other resource.
DISPOSE: End of the flow: parts, orders or customers leave the system here, and their throughput time and holding cost are recorded.
DUPLICATE: Makes copies of an entity, for example to send the same order to several branches or to model one job spawning several; the original goes on unchanged.
HOLD: Holds entities waiting in a queue until a named signal fires, a condition becomes true (a buffer has room, a machine is idle), or for good.
LOGIC: Custom routing written in Python: sends each entity to one of several outgoing links by your own rule when chance or a condition is not enough.
MATCH: Waits until one entity of each of several kinds is present (a part and its kit, an order and its customer), then releases them together.
MOTION: Robot or cobot station whose service is a cycle of timed moves, picks, places and tool changes, so cycle time comes from motion data, not a distribution.
PROCESS: Machine, workstation or service step: a part, order or customer waits for a resource (machine, operator, server), is processed for a time, then frees it.
RECORD: Counts or measures something as entities pass (a count, a time between arrivals, a defect, a cost) in a user-named statistic, without delaying them.
RELEASE: Frees a machine, operator or other resource that an earlier SEIZE gave the entity, after an optional delay.
ROUTE: Sends a part or job to the next station on its own routing sequence (a job-shop or multi-step route) instead of along a fixed link.
SEIZE: Waits in a queue for a machine, operator, vehicle or other resource, takes it and keeps it until a later RELEASE, so one resource can span several steps.
SEND: Sends a message, with an optional payload, to agents of an agent-based model so they can react, for example a customer calling a driver.
SEPARATE: Splits a batch, pallet or lot back into its individual parts, orders or customers, optionally copying the batch's attributes to each.
SIGNAL: Broadcasts a named signal that releases every entity waiting at a HOLD block for it, for example a shift start, a gate opening or a green light.
STATION: Named stop on a job-shop or multi-step routing where a ROUTE block delivers parts, orders or jobs and sets their current location.
TRANSFER: Adds to or takes from a continuous tank, stock or inventory level (fuel, material, a pool) as the entity passes, optionally waiting until it is available.
TRANSPORT: Moves a part, order or load between locations with a vehicle (truck, AGV, forklift, robot) from a fleet: fetch, carry, unload, free the vehicle.
